title: Is breakfast really so important
titleChinese: 吃早餐真的有那么重要吗？
paragraphs: Have you ever heard someone say, “breakfast is the most important meal of the day”, or give you advice about why it’s vital to start the day with a healthy breakfast? It seems that this feast, for many of us, is necessary for our day to start well, but is it really that important?

The word ‘breakfast’ comes from ‘breaking the fast’ – the idea of ending the period in which we didn’t eat during the night. The regeneration process that takes place while we sleep consumes some of our natural food reserves to heal our bodies. Breakfast gives us an opportunity to replenish those depleted stores of things like protein and calcium. So, in that way, a healthy breakfast makes sense.

There are also many often-quoted studies which seem to correlate a state of obesity with skipping breakfast. In fact, it leads many health experts to advise a healthy breakfast to not only regulate but also lose weight. In a US study, 50,000 people were monitored over seven years, and those who ate a healthy breakfast were found to have a lower BMI, which seems to suggest that breakfast may indeed help people maintain a healthy weight.

But it might not be as simple as that. Some experts, like Alexandra Johnstone, professor of appetite research at the University of Aberdeen, suggest those who skip breakfast might be less aware of healthy diets and nutrition, and people who eat breakfast might have a healthier lifestyle overall – exercising and not smoking, for example. And with the rise in popularity of intermittent fasting to lose weight – there may also be some benefits to skipping breakfast. Intermittent fasting can improve blood sugar control, insulin sensitivity, and lower blood pressure.
So, while breakfast has its benefits, it might not be the most important meal. It seems that a healthy lifestyle with a balanced diet might be more important for many of us than just one single meal.

vocabulary.entry: vital /ˈvaɪtl/ adj. 极其重要的
vocabulary.example: Vitamin C is vital for maintaining healthy skin.
vocabulary.translation: 维生素C对维持皮肤健康至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: feast /fiːst/ n. 一餐；盛宴
vocabulary.example: We had a feast of fresh seafood by the coast.
vocabulary.translation: 我们在海边享用了一顿新鲜海鲜大餐。

vocabulary.entry: break the fast /breɪk ðə fɑːst/ 打破禁食状态
vocabulary.example: Muslims break the fast with dates during Ramadan.
vocabulary.translation: 斋月期间，穆斯林会吃椰枣来开斋。

vocabulary.entry: regeneration /rɪˌdʒenəˈreɪʃn/ n. 再生；修复
vocabulary.example: The regeneration of damaged tissue can take several weeks.
vocabulary.translation: 受损组织的修复可能需要数周时间。

vocabulary.entry: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ v. 消耗；耗费
vocabulary.example: The air conditioner consumes a lot of electricity in summer.
vocabulary.translation: 空调在夏天会消耗大量电能。

vocabulary.entry: natural food reserve /ˈnætʃrəl fuːd rɪˈzɜːv/ 天然营养储备
vocabulary.example: The body’s natural food reserves will be used up during starvation.
vocabulary.translation: 饥饿时，身体的天然营养储备会被耗尽。

vocabulary.entry: replenish /rɪˈplenɪʃ/ v. 补充；重新装满
vocabulary.example: We need to replenish our supplies of drinking water before the trip.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要在旅行前补充饮用水储备。

vocabulary.entry: depleted /dɪˈpliːtɪd/ adj. 被耗尽的；枯竭的
vocabulary.example: The drought left the region with depleted water resources.
vocabulary.translation: 干旱导致该地区水资源枯竭。

vocabulary.entry: protein /ˈprəʊtiːn/ n. 蛋白质
vocabulary.example: Chicken and beans are good sources of protein.
vocabulary.translation: 鸡肉和豆类是优质的蛋白质来源。

vocabulary.entry: calcium /ˈkælsiəm/ n. 钙
vocabulary.example: Dairy products are rich in calcium that strengthens bones.
vocabulary.translation: 乳制品富含强化骨骼的钙质。

vocabulary.entry: often-quoted /ˈɒfn ˈkwəʊtɪd/ adj. 被频繁引用的
vocabulary.example: This is an often-quoted passage from the author's most famous novel.
vocabulary.translation: 这是出自该作家最著名小说中一段被频繁引用的文字。

vocabulary.entry: correlate /ˈkɒrəleɪt/ v. 使相互关联
vocabulary.example: Research suggests that smoking correlates with an increased risk of lung disease.
vocabulary.translation: 研究表明，吸烟与肺部疾病风险增加有关联。

vocabulary.entry: obesity /əʊˈbiːsəti/ n. 肥胖症
vocabulary.example: The report highlights the link between obesity and heart disease.
vocabulary.translation: 这份报告强调了肥胖症与心脏病之间的联系。

vocabulary.entry: skip /skɪp/ v. 跳过；不做（应做的事）
vocabulary.example: She decided to skip lunch to finish the project on time.
vocabulary.translation: 她决定不吃午饭，以便按时完成项目。

vocabulary.entry: regulate /ˈreɡjuleɪt/ v. 调节；控制
vocabulary.example: Hormones help to regulate various functions in the human body.
vocabulary.translation: 荷尔蒙有助于调节人体的各项机能。

vocabulary.entry: BMI /ˌbiː em ˈaɪ/ n. 身体质量指数
vocabulary.example: Doctors use BMI to assess whether a person has a healthy weight.
vocabulary.translation: 医生会用身体质量指数来评估一个人的体重是否健康。

vocabulary.entry: appetite /ˈæpətaɪt/ n. 食欲；胃口
vocabulary.example: Fresh air and exercise can boost your appetite.
vocabulary.translation: 新鲜空气和运动能增进食欲。

vocabulary.entry: nutrition /njuˈtrɪʃn/ n. 营养；营养学
vocabulary.example: The course covers the basics of human nutrition and dietetics.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程涵盖了人体营养学和膳食学的基础知识。

vocabulary.entry: intermittent fasting /ˌɪntəˈmɪtənt ˈfɑːstɪŋ/ 间歇性禁食
vocabulary.example: Some people practice intermittent fasting to improve their metabolic health.
vocabulary.translation: 有些人通过间歇性禁食来改善代谢健康。

vocabulary.entry: blood sugar /blʌd ˈʃʊɡə/ n. 血糖
vocabulary.example: Regular exercise can help keep your blood sugar stable.
vocabulary.translation: 规律运动有助于保持血糖稳定。

vocabulary.entry: insulin sensitivity /ˈɪnsjəlɪn ˌsensəˈtɪvəti/ 胰岛素敏感性
vocabulary.example: A diet high in fiber can improve insulin sensitivity in the body.
vocabulary.translation: 高纤维饮食能提高身体的胰岛素敏感性。

vocabulary.entry: blood pressure /blʌd ˈpreʃə/ n. 血压
vocabulary.example: Stress and lack of sleep can cause high blood pressure.
vocabulary.translation: 压力和睡眠不足可能会导致高血压。

vocabulary.entry: balanced diet /ˈbælənst ˈdaɪət/ n. 均衡饮食
vocabulary.example: A balanced diet includes fruits, vegetables and whole grains.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡饮食包含水果、蔬菜和全谷物。

vocabulary.entry: overall /ˌəʊvərˈɔːl/ adj. 整体的；全面的
vocabulary.example: The overall cost of the project is within our budget.
vocabulary.translation: 这个项目的总成本在我们的预算范围内。

vocabulary.entry: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ v. 维持；保持
vocabulary.example: It is important to maintain a positive attitude towards life.
vocabulary.translation: 保持积极的生活态度很重要。

sentences.english: Have you ever heard someone say, “breakfast is the most important meal of the day”, or give you advice about why it’s vital to start the day with a healthy breakfast?
sentences.chinese: 你有没有听过别人说“早餐是一天中最重要的一餐”，或是有人建议你吃一顿健康的早餐对开启新的一天至关重要？

sentences.english: It seems that this feast, for many of us, is necessary for our day to start well, but is it really that important?
sentences.chinese: 对我们很多人来说，这一餐似乎是顺利开启一天的必需品，但它真的有那么重要吗？

sentences.english: The word ‘breakfast’ comes from ‘breaking the fast’ – the idea of ending the period in which we didn’t eat during the night.
sentences.chinese: “早餐（breakfast）”这个词源于“打破禁食（breaking the fast）”，也就是结束夜间禁食状态的意思。

sentences.english: The regeneration process that takes place while we sleep consumes some of our natural food reserves to heal our bodies.
sentences.chinese: 我们睡眠时身体会进行修复再生过程，这个过程会消耗体内储存的部分营养物质来修复身体机能。

sentences.english: Breakfast gives us an opportunity to replenish those depleted stores of things like protein and calcium.
sentences.chinese: 早餐则为我们提供了补充蛋白质、钙等已消耗营养素的机会。

sentences.english: So, in that way, a healthy breakfast makes sense.
sentences.chinese: 从这个角度来说，吃一顿健康的早餐确实是合理的。

sentences.english: There are also many often-quoted studies which seem to correlate a state of obesity with skipping breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 此外，有许多被频繁引用的研究似乎表明，肥胖状况与不吃早餐有关联。

sentences.english: In fact, it leads many health experts to advise a healthy breakfast to not only regulate but also lose weight.
sentences.chinese: 这也使得许多健康专家建议，吃一顿健康的早餐不仅有助于调节体重，还能帮助减重。

sentences.english: In a US study, 50,000 people were monitored over seven years, and those who ate a healthy breakfast were found to have a lower BMI, which seems to suggest that breakfast may indeed help people maintain a healthy weight.
sentences.chinese: 美国一项针对5万人开展的七年追踪研究发现，坚持吃健康早餐的人群身体质量指数（BMI-body mass index）更低，这似乎说明早餐确实有助于人们维持健康体重。

sentences.english: But it might not be as simple as that.
sentences.chinese: 但事情或许并没有这么简单。

sentences.english: Some experts, like Alexandra Johnstone, professor of appetite research at the University of Aberdeen, suggest those who skip breakfast might be less aware of healthy diets and nutrition, and people who eat breakfast might have a healthier lifestyle overall – exercising and not smoking, for example.
sentences.chinese: 阿伯丁大学食欲研究教授亚历山德拉·约翰斯通等专家提出，不吃早餐的人可能本身就对健康饮食和营养学知识了解较少，而吃早餐的人通常有着更健康的整体生活方式——比如坚持锻炼、不吸烟等。

sentences.english: And with the rise in popularity of intermittent fasting to lose weight – there may also be some benefits to skipping breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 此外，随着间歇性禁食减肥法的流行，不吃早餐或许也有其益处。

sentences.english: Intermittent fasting can improve blood sugar control, insulin sensitivity, and lower blood pressure.
sentences.chinese: 间歇性禁食有助于改善血糖控制能力、提高胰岛素敏感性，还能降低血压。

sentences.english: So, while breakfast has its benefits, it might not be the most important meal.
sentences.chinese: 因此，尽管早餐有其好处，但它或许并不是一天中最重要的一餐。

sentences.english: It seems that a healthy lifestyle with a balanced diet might be more important for many of us than just one single meal.
sentences.chinese: 对我们很多人来说，保持健康的生活方式和均衡的饮食，可能比单独重视某一餐要重要得多。
